temporal_state_chain.observed: At the funeral, Sara notices Shirley's somber demeanor and hears her say it has been tough, that she keeps thinking if something more could have been done, and that it is hard to let go.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Before this event, Sara knew Shirley had cared for the mutual patient and might be affected by his death, but she had not yet confirmed how deeply Shirley was struggling.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes - confirms Sara's suspicion and deepens her understanding of Shirley's grief and possible self-doubt.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Shirley is deeply affected by the patient's death, is struggling to let go, and may be questioning whether more could have been done.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To comfort Shirley, reassure her, and help her process the loss.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During a coffee break, Sara raises the topic of treatment decisions. Shirley says she feels responsible, wonders if pushing for a different approach might have helped, appreciates Sara's reassurance, but says it is hard to accept.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believed Shirley was deeply affected by the patient's death and might be carrying some self-doubt or responsibility about the outcome.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes - confirms and sharpens Sara's belief that Shirley feels personally responsible and is second-guessing treatment decisions.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Shirley explicitly feels responsible for the patient's outcome, carries a heavy burden, and finds it difficult to accept reassurance.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Empathy, concern, sadness, and a desire to relieve Shirley's guilt
temporal_state_chain.intention: To alleviate Shirley's sense of responsibility, reassure her that the decisions were made with the available information, and offer support.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Sara notices Shirley has been reserved and minimally expressive. When Sara confronts her, Shirley says she is not sure she can open up, does not want to seem unprofessional or weak, then says she will try to be more open.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believed Shirley was grieving and feeling responsible, and that her reserved behavior meant she was holding back emotions.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes - clarifies why Shirley is reserved and reveals her fear of appearing unprofessional or weak.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Shirley suppresses her emotions partly because she fears being seen as unprofessional or weak, but she may be willing to try being more open.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To encourage Shirley to express her feelings and reassure her that openness is healthy, not a sign of weakness.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Sara apologizes for possibly coming on too strong. Shirley says it was a bit much but knows Sara meant well, appreciates the apology, and says they should keep talking because it helps.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara worried her previous confrontation might have been too harsh and possibly strained their friendship. She still believed Shirley was grieving and needed support but may have been put off by Sara's directness.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes - alleviates Sara's worry by showing Shirley understood her intent and still values their talks.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Shirley felt Sara's approach was a bit much but recognizes Sara meant well, accepts the apology, and wants to continue talking; the friendship is still supportive.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Apologetic and remorseful, then relieved and grateful
temporal_state_chain.intention: To apologize, mend the friendship, and continue being available in whatever way Shirley needs.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After some time, Sara notices Shirley seems to be doing better. Shirley says she is feeling better thanks to their talks and Sara's support. Sara suggests spending more time together outside work, and Shirley agrees to plan something for the weekend.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believed Shirley had been grieving and feeling responsible, was trying to be more open, and had accepted Sara's apology, but Sara was not yet certain how much Shirley had improved.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes - shifts Sara from hoping Shirley might be improving to seeing clear signs of improvement and willingness to continue receiving support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Shirley is improving and values Sara's support; spending time together outside work could help sustain her recovery.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To continue supporting Shirley, plan time together outside work, and help her maintain her improvement.
